word-you-informal.note: you, one person, informal (ru ты, de du, fr tu, es tú)

word-you-formal.note: you, one person, polite (ru вы, de Sie, fr vous, es usted; ja あなた or name+さん)

word-it.note: third person singular for things and animals

word-not.note: negates a verb or adjective: do not, is not

word-okay.note: expression of agreement: OK, all right

word-this.note: near the speaker: this (one) (ja これ/この, es este)

word-that.note: near the listener (ja それ/その, es ese); plain "that" in two-way languages

word-that-over-there.note: far from both speaker and listener (ja あれ/あの, es aquel)

word-here.note: at or to this place, near the speaker (ja ここ)

word-there.note: at that place near the listener (ja そこ, es ahí); plain "there" in two-way languages

word-over-there.note: at a place far from both (ja あそこ, es allí)

word-where.note: question word: in or at what place

word-how-much.note: question about amount or price (ja いくら, ru сколько)

word-how-many.note: question about a countable number (ja いくつ, ru сколько)

word-which.note: question word: which one of several

word-if.note: introduces a condition: if it rains…

word-be.note: identity or essence: X is Y (es/pt ser); the copula

word-be-state.note: temporary state or location: be tired, be at home (es/pt estar)

word-there-is.note: of things: exist, be present: there is a… (ja ある, ko 있다, es hay)

word-there-is-living.note: of people and animals: be present (ja いる)

word-do.note: perform an action: do homework (ru делать, de machen/tun)

word-make.note: create or produce: make a cake

word-go-on-foot.note: go somewhere on foot or in general (ru идти, de gehen, pl iść)

word-go-by-vehicle.note: go by vehicle (ru ехать, de fahren, pl jechać)

word-want.note: wish to have or to do

word-can-able.note: be able to; be possible (ru мочь, de können, pl móc)

word-can-skill.note: know how to do something (ru уметь, fr savoir, pl umieć)

word-know-fact.note: know a fact or information (de wissen, fr savoir, es saber)

word-know-person.note: be acquainted with a person or place (de kennen, fr connaître, es conocer)

word-look.note: direct one's eyes at something: look at

word-listen.note: pay attention to sounds: listen to music

word-take.note: get hold of; take something with you

word-love.note: love a person or thing deeply

word-live-reside.note: reside somewhere: I live in Belgrade (de wohnen)

word-ask-question.note: ask for information (ru спрашивать, de fragen, es preguntar)

word-ask-request.note: ask someone to do or give something (ru просить, de bitten, es pedir)

word-read.note: look at and understand written text

word-write.note: put words on paper or a screen

word-find.note: discover something you were looking for

word-be-called.note: have a name: my name is… (de heißen, ru меня зовут)

phrase-excuse-me.note: to get attention or pass by politely

word-name.note: word by which someone or something is known

word-brother-older.note: older brother; a separate word in ja/zh/ko

word-brother-younger.note: younger brother; a separate word in ja/zh/ko

word-sister-older.note: older sister; a separate word in ja/zh/ko

word-sister-younger.note: younger sister; a separate word in ja/zh/ko

word-home.note: the place where one lives: at home, go home

word-room.note: part of a building with walls

word-chair.note: seat for one person with a back

word-coffee.note: hot drink made from roasted beans

word-tea.note: hot drink made from tea leaves

word-street.note: public road in a town, with buildings

word-ticket.note: paper or pass for travel or entry

word-time.note: time in general; duration: I have no time

word-time-occasion.note: an instance: once, three times (ru раз, de Mal, es vez)

word-evening.note: late part of the day before night

word-month.note: one of the twelve parts of a year

word-monday.note: day of the week after Sunday

word-tuesday.note: day of the week after Monday

word-wednesday.note: day of the week after Tuesday

word-thursday.note: day of the week after Wednesday

word-friday.note: day of the week after Thursday

word-saturday.note: day of the week after Friday

word-sunday.note: day of the week after Saturday

word-world.note: the earth and everyone on it

word-hand.note: body part at the end of the arm: palm and fingers (ru/sr рука also = arm)

word-arm.note: limb from shoulder to wrist (ru/sr рука also = hand)

word-two.note: number 2 (zh 二; 两 before measure words)

word-blue.note: color of the clear sky (ru синий; light blue is separate)

word-old-thing.note: not new (of things; ja 古い)

word-old-age.note: of advanced age (of people and animals; ja 年をとった)

word-many.note: a large number of: many people

word-much.note: a large amount of: much water

word-a-little.note: to a small degree; a small amount

word-get.note: obtain, receive: get a letter, get a job

word-walk.note: move on foot at a normal pace; go for a walk

word-send.note: cause to go somewhere: send a letter or message

word-clean-v.note: remove dirt from: clean the room

word-fly.note: travel by air; move through the air

word-visit.note: go to see a person or place

word-enter.note: go or come into a place

word-go-out.note: leave a room or building; go outside

word-lie-down.note: be or get in a horizontal position

word-cut.note: divide with a knife or scissors

word-play-fun.note: play for fun; play a game or sport (ja 遊ぶ/する)

word-play-instrument.note: play a musical instrument (ja 弾く, zh 弹/拉)

word-mean.note: signify: what does this word mean?

word-count.note: find the number of; say numbers in order

word-cost.note: have a price: it costs ten euros

word-switch-on.note: turn on a device or light

word-switch-off.note: turn off a device or light

word-people.note: persons in general (ru люди, de Leute)

word-student.note: person studying at a university or school

word-body.note: the whole physical structure of a person

word-mouth.note: opening in the face for eating and speaking

word-tooth.note: hard white part in the mouth

word-leg.note: limb you stand on (ru нога also = foot)

word-foot.note: lowest part of the leg (ru нога also = leg; ja 足)

word-finger.note: one of the five parts of the hand (ru палец also = toe)

word-back-body.note: rear part of the body from shoulders to hips

word-stomach.note: belly; the organ that digests food

word-bathroom.note: room with a bath or shower

word-wall.note: vertical side of a room or building

word-light-n.note: brightness; a lamp: turn on the light

word-clock.note: instrument showing time (on a wall or table)

word-fruit.note: edible sweet part of a plant: apples, bananas…

word-restaurant.note: place to buy and eat meals

word-cafe.note: small place for coffee and snacks

word-hospital.note: place where sick people are treated

word-airport.note: place where planes take off and land

word-hotel.note: building where travelers stay and pay

word-office.note: room or building where people work at desks

word-park.note: public green area in a town

word-sun.note: the star that gives us light

word-snow.note: frozen water falling as white flakes

word-weather.note: state of the air: sunny, rainy…

word-taxi.note: car you pay to be driven in

word-game.note: activity with rules played for fun

word-movie.note: film shown in a cinema or on TV

word-fish-animal.note: fish as a living animal (es pez)

word-short-height.note: of small height (of people; ru низкий)

word-right-direction.note: on the right side: turn right

word-left-direction.note: on the left side: turn left

word-between.note: in the space separating two things

word-every.note: each one of a group: every day

word-some.note: a certain amount or number of

word-early.note: before the usual or expected time

word-late.note: after the usual or expected time

phrase-good-night.note: said before going to bed or parting at night

phrase-nice-to-meet-you.note: said when meeting someone for the first time

phrase-help.note: Help! (call for help in an emergency)

word-study.note: study at school or university; do homework (ja 勉強する, de lernen/studieren)

word-my.note: possessive of "I": my book (ja 私の, zh 我的)

word-your-informal.note: possessive of informal singular "you" (ru твой, de dein)

word-your-formal.note: possessive of polite singular "you" (ru ваш, de Ihr)

word-way-method.note: manner or method of doing something (not a road)

word-part.note: piece or portion of a whole

word-address.note: where someone lives: street, number, city

word-vacation.note: holiday away from work or school

word-animal.note: living creature that is not a plant or human

word-rice-cooked.note: cooked rice as a dish (ja ご飯, zh 米饭)

word-market.note: place where goods are sold from stalls

word-apartment.note: set of rooms in a building (flat)

word-building.note: structure with walls and a roof

word-story.note: account of events, real or imagined

word-example.note: something that shows what others are like

word-busy.note: having a lot to do; occupied

word-possible.note: able to happen or be done

phrase-how-much-is-it.note: asking the price: How much is it?
